base_description: Alberto Martínez — a software studio. Custom web apps, bots and automation.
home_h1: I build software with care — bespoke, and built to last.
home_lead: I'm Alberto Martínez. I design and build web apps, bots and automation — from idea to production.
home_projects_intro: A sample of what comes out of the studio. Mostly open on GitHub.
home_project_0_desc: IT services brand for local businesses: web, data, backups, social and AI. Landing built with Astro.
home_project_1_desc: Pull-based GitOps: deploys self-hosted services (bots, daemons) on systemd Linux, with no inbound exposure.
home_project_2_desc: A personal finance app for Android: accounts, budgets, net worth and charts, with data that never leaves the device.
home_project_3_desc: Digital gallery for the Pinatarius 2026 project. The collection, online.
home_project_4_desc: A Telegram bot that looks up Urban Dictionary definitions, with inline queries and a word of the day.

moone_meta_description: Moone, the personal finance app I'm building: accounts, budgets and net worth, with data that never leaves your phone.
moone_lead: Personal finance with no cloud and no accounts — everything stays on your phone. I'm building it to run my own finances, at my own pace.
moone_feature_0: Net worth and income/expense trends, at a glance.
moone_feature_1: Transactions with category, account, notes and tags — with a built-in calculator for splitting bills between people.
moone_feature_2: Accounts and cards grouped together, assets and liabilities always clear.
moone_feature_3: Budgets and daily, weekly and monthly summaries.
moone_screens_intro: Shown with test data, from the app's own demo mode.
moone_screen_0_alt: Moone's home screen: net worth and daily summary
moone_screen_1_alt: Editing a transaction in Moone, with concept, category and account
moone_screen_2_alt: Moone's built-in calculator for working out an amount while logging a transaction
moone_screen_3_alt: Moone's accounts list, with assets and liabilities
moone_how_body_1: Native Android, in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Closed source for now — if I ever publish it, I'll say so here.
